title: fix(fleet-write): key the rerun_failed workflow fence by repository, admit hotcrm's link check
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDypKu7B9nwbu5WuV7AEio8)_

Fixes #37280

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:车队席位现在可以对 hotcrm 的链接检查失败重跑一次,此前中继一律拒绝。
- 为什么做:车队写中继的重跑工具,替在 hotcrm 上遇到偶发链接检查失败的席位解决。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某个只读检查被多跑一次,只花运行时间,不改任何东西;撤回即还原这几行。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

The relay's `run_rerun_failed` workflow fence matched the run's `path` against ONE flat list of objectstack paths (`RERUN_FAILED_WORKFLOWS`), so hotcrm run 45600157624 (`.github/workflows/link-check.yml`, `pull_request`, attempt 1) was refused `fence workflow`.

Route taken: the per-repo fence (the triage's first option). `RERUN_FAILED_WORKFLOWS_BY_REPO` is a frozen table keyed by repository, mirroring the existing `WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_BY_REPO`:

- `objectstack-ai/objectstack`: `ci.yml`, `check-links.yml` (unchanged)
- `objectstack-ai/hotcrm`: `link-check.yml` (new)

The workflow fence now takes the repository the run and pull were read from (`holds(run, pull, repo)`), and both callers pass the one they already hold: the executor its `payload.repo`, the seat wrapper its `--repo`. A path is accepted only on the repository that lists it. objectstack's `ci.yml` on hotcrm is refused, and so is hotcrm's `link-check.yml` on objectstack. A repository with no entry, or no repository at all, re-runs nothing. The other four fences (event, once, failed, head) have the same predicates as before. The workflow refusal now quotes `PATH on REPO` and names the per-repository lists. The head fence's `wants` text is reworded (its predicate is unchanged), because "each listed workflow's concurrency group is keyed by the pull number" is false for hotcrm's file, which declares no concurrency group.

Why not just add the path to the flat list: then objectstack would also accept a `link-check.yml` path, a file it does not have and nobody reviewed, and hotcrm would accept objectstack's `ci.yml`, which is not read-only (it uses turbo cache secrets). The per-repo table costs one small helper, about the same size as adding the path plus its cross-repo exclusions.

Read-only proof for the hotcrm entry: hotcrm's file is not on this repository's disk, so the on-disk check cannot read it. Instead, a verbatim copy is vendored at `scripts/fixtures/rerun-failed/hotcrm.link-check.yml.txt`, read from hotcrm `main` 9b3a9ba9. It is stored as `.txt` so that no workflow or yml scanner in this repo treats it as a real workflow. The self-test checks three things:

1. The copy's git blob id equals `f1e13112314af2d768ac9918915bf355a483704e`, the blob the contents API gave for hotcrm's file. A one-byte change makes the copy fail this check.
2. The copy runs on `pull_request`.
3. The copy passes the same read-only check as objectstack's entries: no secret but `GITHUB_TOKEN`, no `environment:`, a permissions block covering every job, no write scope. Checked against hotcrm's file: top-level `permissions: contents: read`, one job, no secrets, no environment.

**What the test can and cannot prove.** It proves the file as it was when admitted. It cannot see a later edit on hotcrm. A future change to hotcrm's `link-check.yml` that adds a secret or a write scope would not turn anything red here. Re-reading that file is the reviewer's job on the next PR that touches the entry. Every entry for another repository must have a recorded copy, so adding a repository without one fails the self-test.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test`: 496 cases pass across 24 batteries. New or changed cases:
  - the table is pinned exactly and frozen at every level;
  - every key is in the governed-repository roster;
  - a repository with no entry (and `__proto__`) lists nothing;
  - objectstack's own entries are checked on disk;
  - hotcrm's recorded copy passes the blob, `pull_request` and read-only checks;
  - three can-fail controls: one changed byte moves the blob id, `contents: write` is caught as a write scope, `secrets.PAT` is caught as a secret;
  - the git blob function is checked against the empty blob;
  - each listed path is accepted on its own repository and refused on the other repository, on one with no entry, and with no repository.
- `node scripts/pm/rerun-failed.mjs --self-test`: 33 cases pass. Each listed workflow is accepted and dispatched once from the repository that lists it, hotcrm included. Each cross-repository run is refused at the seat with exit 2 and no dispatch.
- `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test`: 474 cases pass. The pinned workflow-refusal sentence now quotes `... on objectstack-ai/objectstack`.
- Ablation: I changed the fence on disk to ignore the repository (any repository's paths accepted). Three cross-repository cases went red: validate 2, rerun-failed 1. Restoring the fence turned them green again.

## Acceptance notes

- hotcrm's `link-check.yml` has no `concurrency:` group, so a re-run on a stale head would not cancel the current head's run. The head fence still refuses stale heads, as before. Only the `wants` wording changed.
- hotcrm's `link-check.yml` uses `gaurav-nelson/github-action-markdown-link-check@v1`, pinned by tag rather than commit sha. This is outside this card and not filed; it is noted because the read-only check does not judge third-party action pins.
- hotcrm's `ci.yml` is not admitted. The card's evidence names only the link checker.

## Verification

Read these first, by risk:

1. `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`: the `RERUN_FAILED_WORKFLOWS_BY_REPO` table, `rerunFailedWorkflows`, and the workflow fence's `holds(run, pull, repo)`.
2. `scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs`: the `RECORDED` / `gitBlobId` block and the cross-repo refusals.
3. `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs`: the one call site that passes `payload.repo`.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test` prints `496 cases pass`. In the same tree, `git hash-object scripts/fixtures/rerun-failed/hotcrm.link-check.yml.txt` prints `f1e13112314af2d768ac9918915bf355a483704e`.

<details><summary>Local gates at 806aa237 (tree identical to eaf47551, where they ran; only the commit message was reworded)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 64 families. 63 exited 0, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` included (fast tier: 2360 cases).
- `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` is NOT MEASURED. Reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because the workspace CLI is not built (`packages/cli/dist/commands/lint.js`). This diff touches no package. Its `--self-test` half passed. CI runs it.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 64 derived, 63 run, 1 unrun (the one above).
- No changeset: `scripts/pm/**` and `scripts/fixtures/**` are private tooling that no package's `files[]` ships, so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.

</details>
